title: Walrus Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.13689v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Walrus, a unified 8B speech-and-audio foundation model handling speech recognition (including code-switching and multi-talker speech), speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, text-to-speech, emotion recognition, audio captioning, and general audio understanding. Our main contribution is not a new architecture but a data-centric training recipe; we use a standard decoder-only backbone initialized from Gemma 4, so that gains can be traced to the data. For speech generation, Walrus predicts low-bitrate discrete speech tokens, and a lightweight token-to-waveform decoder converts them into high-fidelity audio. The recipe is a three-stage data curriculum that moves from broad multilingual data to multi-talker, code-switching, and domain-specific data. At each stage, task-aware and dataset-aware weighting balances tasks with very different token budgets and protects core skills from forgetting. Trained on over 600M samples

translated_abstract: 我们提出 Walrus，一个统一的 8B 语音与音频基础模型，能够处理语音识别（包括语码转换和多说话人语音）、语音到文本与语音到语音翻译、文本到语音、情感识别、音频描述生成以及通用音频理解。我们的主要贡献并非新架构，而是一套以数据为中心的训练方案；我们使用从 Gemma 4 初始化的标准 decoder-only 骨干网络，从而使性能提升可以明确归因于数据。在语音生成方面，Walrus 预测低码率的离散语音 token，再由轻量级的 token 到波形解码器将其转换为高保真音频。该方案采用三阶段数据课程，从广泛的多语言数据逐步过渡到多说话人、语码转换和特定领域数据。在每个阶段，任务感知与数据集感知的加权机制平衡了 token 预算差异极大的各项任务，并保护核心技能免遭遗忘。模型在超过 6 亿个样本上训练。
tldr: Walrus 是一个统一的 8B 语音与音频基础模型，其核心贡献在于一套以数据为中心的三阶段课程训练方案：在标准 decoder-only 骨干上通过任务感知加权，实现从多语言到多说话人、语码转换等场景的广泛语音理解与生成能力。
en_tdlr: Walrus is a unified 8B speech-and-audio foundation model whose key contribution is a data-centric, three-stage curriculum training recipe on a standard decoder-only backbone, enabling broad speech understanding and generation through task-aware data weighting.
